name: Ajay Sanyal
role: IB Director (Intelligence Bureau) — Hamza's strategic handler
real_life_inspiration: Ajit Doval — India's current National Security Advisor, former IB Director, and the so-called 'Godfather of Indian covert operations'. Spent years undercover in Pakistan himself in the 1980s–90s.

inspiration_notes.ajit_doval_parallel: Doval was IB Director from 2004-2005 before becoming NSA under Modi (2014–present). Known for orchestrating real covert ops including the 1988 Maldives counter-coup. The film uses 'IB Director' rather than NSA to place the story in the 2001-2008 UPA era.
inspiration_notes.godfather_of_covert_ops: Doval is credited with personally supervising India's Karachi network in the 1990s — the film externalises this as Sanyal actively running Hamza.
inspiration_notes.era_note: In the film's timeline (triggered by the 2001 Parliament attack), Sanyal as IB Director is consistent with the UPA-era institutional structure. Part 2's 'Naya Bharat' framing implies Sanyal may gain more power post-2014.
